senses.gloss: m. (ינק) suckling (infant or animal); cmp. יַנְקָא. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 א׳ די דהבא a suckling (kid?) of gold (lying, on the third step, opposite נמרא [not נשרא] the panther; ref. to Is. XI, 6). Pl. (אֶנְקִין) אֱנָקִין.
units: <cite ref="Isaiah 11:6">Ib.</cite> (end) <he>א׳ בכיין</he> the sucklings were crying.
